identity.title: Integrated AI surveillance of wastewater: One health approach for pathogen detection and cancer risk assessment.

content.abstract: Wastewater becomes one of the important pools for Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) and on fmicrobial signatures, representing the health status of the population at large using the One Health approach. This study suggests an integrated methodology applying shotgun metagenomics, machine learning algorithms, and biosensor technology in order to tackle the problem of diagnostic latency inherent in existing approaches to the assessment of the threat. With the help of genome-resolved metagenomics, the resistome of the wastewater is being characterized, focusing on the characterization of the -lactamases and mobile genetic elements responsible for the horizontal gene transfer process. In addition, the study analyzes the presence of biofilm-associated factors as well as virulence factors associated with carcinogenesis and represented by the pks genomic island in E. coli and the FadA protein in F. nucleatum. Machine learning algorithm architecture is used for the analysis of the network in order to determine the correlations between changes in the microbial community and emerging public health challenges. Moreover, CRISPR-based and electrochemical biosensors are being designed for the rapid and deployable surveillance in the field.
